description: Create, edit, assign, organize or close work. Every change here changes Goals; answering, withdrawing or asking Questions stays in contact. Each change applies independently: a refused one names why (`results[i].error`, e.g. goal_revision_conflict, goal_children_open, goal_not_found) and the rest still apply, so read every result: a partial result is never a complete success. Kinds: complete (goalId, message capped at 50 characters, units, reply, optional next-step options {label, hint}) closes and reports atomically, exactly as contact.completions; create (title, outcome, ownerId, parentGoalId, sourceEntryIds) returns the new Goal's id in `results[i].goalId`, in the order requested, to use in later calls (an outcome is one paragraph, at most 500 characters: split more into child Goals with parentGoalId); edit (title and/or outcome); state (open, completed, canceled); assign (ownerId); defer (until: the Goal waits until then and its owner is woken when it passes; null takes it back); move (parentGoalId, or null for a root: only this Goal moves); dependency (add or remove: goalId waits on dependsOnGoalId to start or to complete). A Goal cannot be completed while its required children or dependencies remain open: finish or move them first. Finishing the children does not prove the parent's own work is done. An edit applies at the version you last read: if someone changed the Goal since, it is refused as goal_revision_conflict, so read it again (get_goals) and reconsider. You may change any Goal of your person; a change puts you on it. Returns `ok` (every change applied), `results` per change (applied or failed), and `goals`, each changed Goal's id, state, title, outcome and revision.

changes.description: The changes, applied in order, each on its own.

outcome.description: The desired result, one paragraph of at most 500 characters. More than that is more work: create child Goals under it (parentGoalId). There is no third description field.

ownerId.description: Who owns the work: an agent's participant (as check_activity shows it) or the person's. Omitted: you.

parentGoalId.description: The Goal it belongs under. Omitted: a root.

sourceEntryIds.description: The whole Entries the work came from, ones you can read.

title.description: The Goal's short display name: one to five words, how a person refers to it out loud.

message.description: Completion headline, at most 50 characters: the one thing that would go wrong or stay unclear later if they missed it.

options.description: Optional next steps the person may initiate: label (50 characters) and consequence in hint (200). Selecting one acknowledges the report and requests that step from its author; it never reopens this Goal.

reply.description: One acknowledgement in the person's voice, at most 50 characters. Acknowledgement alone requests no follow-up and does not claim they tested the work.

units.description: Suggest initial state, changes, current state with verification and limits, and next steps / leftover work with its owner when useful. One idea per unit; omit unnecessary sections.

goalId.description: The Goal to change, as a read shows it.
